node.title: Re: How might one determine empty XML payload?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [vlturner],

Here's one way:

my $xml = q{}; my $dom = XML::LibXML->load_xml(string=>$xml); my $isEmpty = !$dom->documentElement->nonBlankChildNodes; print "isEmpty: ", ($isEmpty?"yes":"no"), "\n"; __END__ isEmpty: yes

This method has the advantage that whitespace inside the tag is ignored. If you don't want that, and want to know specifically when the tag has no content at all, use hasChildNodes instead of nonBlankChildNodes.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
